title: Intel's foundry ambitions could get a massive boost from Nvidia, Google and Amazon
key_facts: A roadmap attributed to GFHK and shared on X lists Amazon, Google, Qualcomm, Microsoft and Nvidia as potential external customers of Intel Foundry's advanced packaging in 2027-2029.
Amazon could be first, possibly for third-generation Trainium AI accelerators in the first half of 2027, and again for fourth-generation in 2H 2028 to 1H 2029.
Nvidia could use Intel's services for its upcoming Feynman GPU architecture; Google and Qualcomm are listed for 2H 2027, Google possibly for TPUs.
The chart places Intel's 18A in 2H 2026, 18A-P in 2H 2027 and 14A between 2H 2028 and 1H 2029, subject to change.
Intel's EMIB-T and EMIB-M packaging could offer an alternative to TSMC's CoWoS, but TSMC is expected to keep an advantage in maturity and yields through at least 2028.
The roadmap remains an analyst projection and not an official list of Intel Foundry customers.
